text.Space Station:
How to Play ==
When you play the Space Station you get 2 Combat Power. When the ally ability triggers you get another 2 combat. Scrapping it gives you 4 trade. the Space Station is an outpost with a defense of 4
 Strategy ==
For 4 trade you get a decent Outpost with a defense of 4. With help of an ally card it puts out a Combat of 4. Most of the time this card is taken for its scrapping ability. 4 extra trade brings even the most powerful cards within reach.
